candidates.review_text: The food was delicious and fresh. I love the vibes and the set up. Service was a little slow, they needed more staff, but other than that great service and great experience.

I thought that the dishes were very nuanced and it was obvious that this was haut cuisine. The ingredients were very unique and it was a pleasure to try everything. 

My complaints are that the mains I tried were not really that tastey. I thought that the tofu main was a bit bland (though the sauce on the side was good), and the grilled carrot main had a very strong taste that didn't seem to match the other items on the plate.

I really like the food here. Extremely fast delivery and good service anytime I've order. However, nothing is ever really flavorful or seasoned very well. I literally have to go home and add seasonings to whatever I buy because the flavor is so bland. So strange. But once again, the food is well made and fresh. So hey. Win some lose some.

RJ brought me here on Friday, Feb 15.  We were going to make a reservation for later, but asked how long to get a table and we were told about 2 hours.  We went upstairs to check it out, but it was packed and no room to move so we came back down.  There were 2 seats at the bar, score!  We were starving and ordered several of the Happy Hour appetizers. RJ asked the bartender if we could have them come out one at a time, and she said she would have them come out as they were ready.  Which was all at once.  Definitely not what we wanted, but no matter,  the food was fabulous. Next time we will order one at a time. I also had the Twizzle which is vodka, strawberry purée, and lemon with a licorice wheel. Omg these were so delicious!! We had quesadillas, humus which I have never had before, chicken skewers, brussel sprouts, pork sliders, and something I can't remember.  Everything was full of flavor and cooked perfectly. We really enjoyed it here.
Hands down to your kitchen, every platter was delicious and waiter services on point. What a delicious wonderful experience and ambiance. Its hard to find good restaurants today.
Heard the food was wonderful, and it did not disappoint! Very tasty with an explosion of flavor. Quick service and very reasonable.
Delicious! We ordered delivery and were very pleased with the flavors and portions. Very high quality ingredients, creative flair and an overall excellent experience.

So glad I finally dined here. Nice dining room (if a little unatmospheric), excellent menu, attentive service, good quality ingredients, spot on presentation, delicious desserts. Will most certainly go back.

Food was absolutely delicious. Appetizers, salads, and mains were all great. We ordered a bunch and split them all. There are some different plates on the menu that you don't see everywhere which was also cool. 
Service was a little young/green with staff forgetting drinks and other requests but nothing tremendously detrimental to the experience. Go there!

I love this restaurant. All of the vegetables are cooked to the perfect texture,  the sauces are delicious, and the stir-fry portions are perfectly huge. I'm a big eater so it's a great lunch portion for me, but more nornal people could probably make one stir-fry last two meals. Everything is so fresh and unladen with that restaurant grossness (sugar, oil, salt) that makes me hate Chinese food. I feel like I'm eating something as healthy as a home-cooked meal. I love the touchscreens and the honeybar and all the friendly employees!
We had an incredible meal here. Every dish was flavorful and unique. It's a small place, and a little crowded inside, but the food more than makes up for it. This place is the real deal.

Adorable decor, great service and delicious food. 

Very rich flavor profiles. I love veggies, do not eat red meat or poultry so the options for someone with dietary restrictions is very limited. 

Overall a good experience.
Food was fresh and tasted delicious. I would def order from here again. I would only do pickup or delivery as the restaurant isnt that nice.

This place looks like the food would be terrible, but it's delicious. On occasion, I like an over-the-top tacky restaurant with fun drinks. I had really low expectations because of the decor, but it was actually really fresh and well-cooked. Maybe that's how they trick you - you go in there thinking "There is no possible way this is going to be good", and then you are pleasantly surprised. I didn't even have a problem with the tiny portions. The food is so rich and heavy that I didn't want a huge amount of it.

Next time I want to sit in the car.

What a delightful and delicious little spot. Little Fish has about 12 tables. The chalk board menu is small with two oyster choices, about six other fish appetizers, and three fish entrees.

Our meal started with an amuse bouche of muscles served on a crispy wafer (see photo) We started with Hamachi with pistachio and fennel (see photo) and the Madai, a flavorful Japanese fish served with leeks and blood oranges. They were both wonderful. I loved the texture of the pistachio, fennel and Hamachi combined. The Madai paired with citrus and leeks was a flavor explosion.

My friends each had the wild king salmon with creme fraiche, kale and beets (see photo). It was a sizable piece and moist to my liking. I had the black cod (see photo) with seafood rouille over rice. It was succulent and wonderful. The rice was flavorful and moist, more like a risotto.

Everything was creative, fresh and delicious. The presentations were artistic. A thoroughly enjoyable meal.

My husband and I decided to try out Amada for our second wedding anniversary. Despite our anniversary falling on a Tuesday in June, the restaurant was packed and I was glad we made reservations. The decor and ambiance were both very appealing, though the noise level and close proximity of tables could do with some work. If you are looking for an intimate date night, this is not the place for you. But my husband and I were fine with minimal chatter throughout dinner.

Having poured through online reviews prior to our visit, we made our own tasting menu of the best sounding dishes. We were not disappointed. The red sangria that I ordered was perfectly spiced, sweet and boozy, though my husband was not too impressed with his Spanish lager. Our server was friendly, but we felt as though he forgot us a few times - we had our first dish on the table before we had anything to drink. Speaking of the food, we really enjoyed almost everything we tried. My favorites were the spicy potatoes, the crab stuffed peppers, the short rib flatbread, and the asparagus. The presentation and freshness of the food is evident, even though the chef went a little overboard with the salt on occasion. Thankfully, the man pouring the water came around very frequently.

The food was fabulous, but the restaurant itself could use some tightening up in the service department, better pacing of the dishes, and about five less tables in the main dining area. I would definitely return, and try some of the other delicious sounding menu options!

This place is absolutely enormous. It surprised me how many huge dining rooms there are, yet even when packed with customers everything seems to be efficiently run and service was outstanding.

Everything that I ate was delicious and I tried maybe 1% of the offerings! Fried items were hot, crisp and absolutely not greasy. Crab legs were delicious & everything turns over so quickly that the dishes are all very fresh.

We sat in the very back dining room that protects you from the noisy frenzy. We'll be back!

Beautiful, tasty food in a lovely setting. The space is cozy without feeling crowded with impressive light fixtures, TALL doorways and windows. But to the important pieces...

+ Old fashioned made with rum, rye, and sweet potato syrup was just a hint sweet, but smooth
+ Smoked trout salad- delish! Cold crisp greens and chunks of tasty fish. The salad was topped with a generous sprinkle of cheese and flavorful herbs
+ Ricotta ravioli- 6 perfectly cooked pieces of pasta in a pretty orange carrot sauce
+ Scallops with roasted cauliflower- 4 seared and juicy pieces with colorful cauliflower, plump golden raisins, and a crazy good creamy sauce
+ Delicata squash with candied peanuts, lemongrass and ginger syrup. This sounded really unusual, but tasted pretty good.

Our server was sweet, letting us take our time and enjoy the meal. Food came out at a good pace and each dish had such unique flavors. Recommend!

While we were excited to taste the food at this well reviewed restaurant, aside from the very fine servers, we were completely underwhelmed. The food was bland and poorly seasoned. We ate a variety of dishes and without exception they were tasteless.
Food was bland and restaurant needed an update. For such rave reviews was highly disappointed. Samon and spinach had no spinach and the rice taste like nothing but oil.

Food was terrible. Everything was dried out and overcooked. I ordered the eggs over medium and they were over easy. The toast was stale. The bacon was so dried out that I felt like I was eating poor quality jerky. The potatoes were undercooked on the inside and overcooked on the outside, also flavorless. It was a really overpriced, poor quality, and flavorless food.

really disappointed with this place. The food was so bland, and came all came out way too quickly. Clearly, they forgot to season their dishes and were more focused on pushing out food. After seeing so many great reviews, I truly expected a very different experience. We ordered the crab wontons, Kobe beef satay, Korean BBQ satay, shrimp(way over cooked) lettuce cups and veggie pad Thai. Horribly disappointed in all these dishes.

I ordered a bunch of dim sum dishes from here a week ago and when I say it was a disappointment, I mean it was a MAJOR disappointment. The chicken feet I ordered was not only not prepared correctly, it was under-cooked! The starch was not cooked, the chicken was cold -- it was disappointing. I also ordered rice rolls (which were cold and under-cooked), rice rolls w shrimp (under-cooked), shrimp har gow (...you guessed it: undercooked! You're starting to see the theme here, right??), siu mai (cold and pork was under-cooked so I threw it out. Not tryna die over under-cooked siu mai pork!! The only thing that turned out right were the spring rolls -__- 

I've been missing dim sum like crazy and when I finally had the opportunity to order some...I was left with a big mess of under-cooked disappointment. 

Not to mention this was me giving this place a second try; I've been here a couple years ago for their dim sum and was not impressed. Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on you AND me!! 

I don't think I will be returning to Nom Wah -- for both delivery/take out and dine in. Hard pass.

I dont know what happened to this place.
The food is bad. Thats all i can say. 
Not once or twice a bad meal but 4x
I like the atmosphere but the food is bland and tastes old! 
Sorry! 
Too many stomach aches

Something about the food has changed within the last year.  We eat here periodically, and last night the food was very bland.  My wife had 2 slices of pizza which lacked flavor and I had a mini sausage boli which also lacked flavor.  The onion rings we had were very over cooked and again, lacked flavor.  

The food used to be much better.  Maybe the management changed suppliers, but whatever the reason behind the bland food it's bad.  I doubt we'll be returning.

Awful awful place they said everything was fresh but when we ate it the texture the taste the food was old and chewy and chalky.the rice undercooked and hard.the meat overcooked soft.desert like biting into concrete. All of it was extremely old even though they said it was fresh.

For this place to be "fine dining" highly disappointed. Nothing stood out, food was bland and needed a lot of seasoning. The only thing good about the place is the food was cooked well but had no taste. 

Do not recommend, do not go and I won't be going back. For the manager who comments the same thing. Try reading the reviews and making changes. Stop replying by saying the same thing over and over again.

Let me first start by saying the food was not hit or miss. It was plain and simple miss. 

The menu is also very, very descriptive. I wasn't quite sure if I was reading a trashy romance novel or a food menu. Each food item had a paragraph long description talking about the orgasmic (literally) qualities of each menu item.   Quotes such as "...will seduce even the most demanding palate" and "this dish brings out a cry for joy when tasted..." were abundant.  I didn't cry out for joy but I did cry out for more flavor because everything was so bland. 

One redeeming factor was the drink menu which had very strange names such as Wild Passion and Future Traditions but were excellent.

Service was fine and accommodating, but the food was just totally bland and uninspired. There were five of us, and we ordered a variety of dishes ranging from pasta to risotto to veal. No one was impressed.

The veal had little taste or seasoning. The seafood didn't seem fresh. The pasta doesn't come across as freshly made, and the risotto was under cooked.

If you've ever had true, great Italian food, you will likely find this restaurant stuffy and lackluster.

Maybe I'm just a spoiled foodie who loves to explore new restaurants and food while traveling! Unfortunately this place missed the mark as the food was not up to par at all. The waitress was extremely nice however I was honestly expecting so much more due to the reviews on here. The food was bland and boring. We had to keep asking the chef to add more garlic, more seasoning. I left the entire dish. We went back to the hotel and ordered take out. Definitely removing this place from my collection!

Disgraceful-- bland tuna, too salty beef, tempura was very, very heavy. Flavors were overpowering or non-existent. Cocktails were weak, and served in glasses full of mostly ice. 
Service was distracted, sloppy, indifferent. Had to ask for utensils after flagging down staff who stood around chatting with each other.  Restaurant seems to be coasting on reputation alone. 
Color changing decor was pleasant but did not make up for an environment that was overly loud, making it impossible to carry on any conversation without yelling. 
To sum up: bad food, bad service, bad atmosphere. Bad all around.

The food was very bland. The restaurant week menu was terrible and entertainment at the end of dinner was so horrible to listen to that we had to get out of there. Overall not impressed w this place and my expectations were high. The place is nice looking and very big but food just didn't cut it.

I ordered two dishes, both were bland. NO SEASONING. Not even soy sauce helped this bland food. Pepper steak had no gravy, just peppers and onions, meat and rice, and no taste whatsoever. The other order was pretty much the same. 

This was my first and last time ordering from this establishment.

RIPPED OFF!!!!

Total slime balls!!

Note: there are no prices listed on the truck.  (At least not during the 2nd Street Festival in NoLibs.)

My friend went there and ordered the fried chicken platter with an extra side of yams.  The guy working there told him it would be $14 for the platter and $2 for the side.  He said ok, I'll be right back and left to go pick something up really quickly.

He comes back to pick up the food and forks over a $20 bill for he order.  They take it and he asks for his change.  (Should be $4.)  Instead of giving him his change back, they tell him it is $20 - $16 for the platter and $4 for the side.  (Sudden price increase?!?!)

My friend argues with them briefly and tells him that isn't what they agreed to before and he just wants the change.  The guy refuses so my friend leaves, having paid an extra $4.

Bottom line: don't eat here!  They're dishonest and completely rude.

Oh, and on top of that, the food was bland.  Spent $20 for bland food.  Shame.

(No, my opinion about the food wasn't biased by his experience.  He told me after we ate so I would still enjoy my food and not go out and tear them a new one.)

This place has gotten progressively worse over the years. Everything is just so bland. The last time I went with my wife, and 3 kids I was so disappointed. I bit into a roll from our basket, and there was a spent cherry from a cigarette stuck to the side that I didn't see. I bit into it, and my whole mouth tasted like an actual ashtray. I got salmon croquettes. They were on top of what seemed to be boxed mashed potatoes, covered in a flavorless white sauce, and they were accompanied by a small bowl of canned green beans. It doesn't seem like they try anymore. Bland, bland, bland. They put a carrot slice, and a piece of kale on every plate that comes out. Why don't you use that money from the garnish which gets thrown in the trash to invest in salt, pepper, dill, parsley, paprika, thyme... ANYTHING. Breakfast is all they are good for anymore. Now they are changing their hours, and closing overnight. Unfortunately I think this place is circling the drain. It's sad. The owners seem like nice people. It will also be terrible to have ANOTHER abandoned building on Frankford Ave. if they do close their doors for good. USed to be such a treat to go there.
Food was bland and completely uninspired. The real disappointment was the terrible customer service and rude wait staff. No wonder the place was crowded.

中文含义：菜品质量从很差到很好
用户希望的方向：higher
满足要求的英文含义：["The food is delicious, fresh, flavorful, and cooked well.", "The dishes taste excellent and the ingredients are high quality."]
违反要求的英文含义：["The food is bland, stale, badly cooked, or tastes terrible.", "The dishes are undercooked, overcooked, flavorless, or poor quality."]

请从输入评论中恰好选择4条：2条明确满足要求，expected_direction=positive；2条明确违反要求，expected_direction=negative。每条评论最多使用一次。

要求：

1. query_text 必须是自然的中文找餐馆问题，只表达当前固定特征和指定方向。
2. query_text 不得出现商家名称、评论编号，也不得暗示已经知道答案。
3. requirement_text 用简短中文写清需要评论回答的要求。
4. evidence_span 必须逐字复制 review_text 中一段连续原文；不能翻译、改写、拼接或补字。
5. 原文必须能够直接证明正面或反面。泛泛的总体好评、差评、星级倾向和意思不清楚的句子不能使用。
6. 如果评论只提到相邻概念但不能证明当前特征，不要选择。
7. 4条样本的问题可以换自然说法，但不能改变指定特征和用户希望的方向。
8. 证据必须直接说明商家确实满足或违反要求。仅仅说“A比B更好/更差”、假设以后会怎样、或者只有在某个未满足条件下才成立，都不能当作明确证据。
9. 只返回下面这一种JSON结构，不要增加字段，不要返回Markdown代码块，不要解释：

{
  "drafts": [
    {
      "seed_review_id": "必须来自候选的review_id",
      "query_text": "自然中文问题",
      "requirement_text": "简短中文要求",
      "expected_direction": "positive或negative",
      "evidence_span": "从对应review_text逐字复制的连续原文"
    }
  ]
}

drafts必须恰好有4项，且必须是2项positive和2项negative。
